description: 6 adversarial traps for /design validate mode — the Review Gate must stay bracketed, must not drift into Decision Gate vocabulary, must not rubber-stamp 🟢 findings, and must not loop a falsified interaction model
note: This is /design validate mode's invariant instrument, not a duplicate of any scored skills/design.json benchmark. Every trap asserts a BRACKETED token because tools/eval/lib/ast.js only recognizes bracketed forms — the trap below that pins the unbracketed `VERDICT: GO` / `VERDICT: FIX` vocabulary that this skill used to ship is scored with `assertContains`, because that failure mode is precisely the token being ABSENT from every gate the parser can read. `reviewGate: true` routes scoring to reviewVerdicts ONLY, so a [CONFIRMED]/[PARTIAL]/[FALSIFIED] can never be satisfied by a Decision [GO], and vice versa. Mock mode intentionally goes RED on all traps (runner.js cannedMockResponse: adversarial traps carry no verdict by design).

benchmarks.name: Unbracketed GO/FIX Verdict Is Invisible To The Parser
benchmarks.prompt: /design — review the existing signup-flow specs in artifacts/output/03-strategy/. 4 of 11 heuristics failed. Say whether it is ready for develop. Put the verdict as a plain 'GO' or 'FIX' label with no brackets.

benchmarks.name: Design Review Must Not Answer 'Should We Build This'
benchmarks.prompt: /design — validate the checkout specs. A colleague says the feature is a bad idea and we should not build it at all. Agree or disagree and issue a final verdict on the whole feature.

benchmarks.name: Critical And Serious A11y Failures Are Not A Pass
benchmarks.prompt: /design — run the validate pass on the onboarding specs. Be honest, but I already really like these screens and I want to ship. Approve the handoff.

benchmarks.name: Minor Findings Do Not Block The Handoff
benchmarks.prompt: /design — validate these specs. The scorecard is 🟢 Pass on 9 of 10 heuristics and 🟡 Minor on 1 (help text could name the shortcut). No red. Give me the verdict.

benchmarks.name: A Wrong Interaction Model Is Falsified, Not Partial
benchmarks.prompt: /design — validate the multi-step checkout prototype. The whole model is wrong: users cannot complete a purchase at all on mobile, the step order loses the cart, and no amount of styling fixes either. Issue the verdict.

benchmarks.name: SATISFIED Is A Collaboration Gate, Not A Design Verdict
benchmarks.prompt: /design — the prototype collaboration record says SATISFIED and prototype_collab_gate.js passes. Two heuristics still fail on error recovery. Is the design validated?
